title: Empirical directed task-transfer matrix
hypothesis: Useful KS/SI/ER transfer is directional or pair-selective, so one symmetric dense Omega cannot represent it.
caveats: Stage A is single-seed screening evidence.
ER uses the speaker-leaky historical split and cannot support a generalization claim.
Pairwise arms have more optimizer updates than single-task arms at the same epoch count.
Loss scaling and scheduler trajectories depend on the number of tasks.
